subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Where a feature is draft-born, the system shall route a requirement defect found during tech-spec work through FR-8 and FR-9 in place of prd:tech-design-brainstorm/FR-14 and prd:tech-design-brainstorm/NG-6.
rationale: This contract overrides the design bounce rows for draft-born features (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-15)
fit_criterion: A fixture tech-spec session that finds a requirement defect produces a requirement problem in the same draft and zero amendment proposals.
